# Paths where a Claude review alone does not satisfy `review-evidence`.
#
# A PR touching any of these needs evidence from `coderabbitai[bot]` — a second,
# independent reviewer that shares no model, no prompt, and no failure modes with
# the lane under review. Two things follow from that and neither is optional:
#
#   * `.github/workflows/review-admit.yml` auto-applies `review-ready` on a match,
#     so admission is not something an agent has to remember;
#   * `.github/scripts/review-evidence.sh` keeps a matched PR RED until that
#     evidence exists, because a label can be skipped and a PR-branch workflow can
#     be tampered with, while the publisher runs from the default branch.
#
# Chosen from where the independent lane has actually earned its keep: every
# CodeRabbit catch on the #301 track landed in `.github/**`, including two the
# adjudicating model had ruled acceptable.
#
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. One glob per line, matched against
# each changed path. `**` matches across directory separators.
#
# ADDING a path is cheap and safe. REMOVING one means asserting that an
# independent review is no longer worth its cost there — say why in the PR.

# The gate itself, and everything that can publish or influence a required check.
.github/**

# Credential and crypto handling.
packages/@prismalens/*/src/**/crypto/**
packages/@prismalens/*/src/**/credential*/**
packages/@prismalens/*/src/**/*secret*

# The engine core: what an investigation is allowed to do.
packages/@prismalens/engine/src/**

# Contracts and schema — anything a consumer or a stored row depends on.
packages/@prismalens/contracts/src/**
packages/@prismalens/database/prisma/**
